byPath.*: Builds the invoice of one billing cycle of a mobile plan: pro rata plan changes, graduated data overage, promotions, data rollover and VAT
byPath.BillingCycle: One billing cycle of an account: the period, the tax country, the customer type, the data used, the plan periods and the promotions
byPath.BillingCycleFacts: The days of the cycle, the plan at the end of the cycle and whether the customer has a VAT ID
byPath.DataUsage: The included data, the extra data billed by the started GB, the unused data, the rollover and the overage charge
byPath.Discounts: The discount of every promotion, pro rata for its valid days
byPath.Invoice: The invoice lines, the net amount, the VAT and the total
byPath.PlanPeriod: A part of the cycle with one plan, from its start date to its end date
byPath.PlanPeriodFacts: The days of a plan period and its share of the cycle
byPath.Promotion: A promotion code with a discount percent on the recurring charges, valid until a date
byPath.PromotionFacts: The days of the cycle on which the promotion is valid
byPath.RecurringCharges: The monthly fee of every plan period, pro rata for its days
byPath.Tier: A tier of the data overage price: the upper limit in GB and the price per GB
byPath.TierLine: The GB billed in one tier and their amount
byPath.billCycle: Bills one cycle and returns the invoice and the data usage
byPath.graduatedCharge: Splits the extra GB over the price tiers, from the first tier up, and stops when no GB are left
byPath.overageTiers: The graduated price of extra data
byPath.planCatalog: The plans: monthly fee, included data and rollover cap
byPath.tiersBook: The graduated price of 27 GB of extra data
byPath.tiersBook.charge: The charge of every tier and the total
byPath.upgradeBook: A consumer who upgrades from the Start plan to the Plus plan in the middle of February and uses more data than included
byPath.vatTreatment: The VAT rate by country, customer type and VAT ID, with reverse charge for EU business customers
